notes.title: Chapter 2 is released as a free update!
notes.notes:
As we promised before we updated the game with the chapter 2 completely free for all the people who purchased the chapter 1! And yes, chapter 3 will be also free!  

Thanks to all the people who purchased the game and have giving us their support!

notes.title: Screenshots of the 2nd chapter!
notes.notes:
Here are the first screnshots of the new chapter of Alexia Crow, that will be called "The deal of the gods" and it will be completly free if you have already purchased the game.

[img]http://www.questtracers.com/Alexia%20Gifs/alex2sc1.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.questtracers.com/Alexia%20Gifs/alex2sc2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.questtracers.com/Alexia%20Gifs/alex2sc3.jpg[/img]

This time Alexia will face Typhoon, one of the most temible monsters in the ancient greek and she will discover the origins of the cave and the achievement that she must complete.

Also we have released a new game in steam greenlight, its Nonogram Pirates (working title) a casual game in which you will need to solve nonograms in order to get treasures with the help of Treasure the pirate!

Hope you like it!

notes.title: Chapter 2 and 3 will be FREE
notes.notes:
Hi!

I just want to tell you that chapter 2 and 3 will come to Alexia Crow as a free updates of the game! 

The release dates of the chapters are not decided, but they will depend on the performing of the game!

Thanks for your support!
